items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think I have one of his books downstairs, a book of his life with a picture of Venus Wilson in his book.

ctx.x: It‟s the truth and in Gershwin‟s book there‟s a picture… I think I have one of his books downstairs, a book of his life with a picture of Venus Wilson in his book. It doesn‟t say what that close connection…
I had no idea. I know she was close to Huby Blake. She and many of those ladies that were really the top singers for the shows and all that stuff, they were wonderful.
